defs.meaning: 影响，对……起作用（influence 的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: He was influenced by the minimalists in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 他受到了20世纪70年代那些极简抽象派艺术家们的影响。

examples.en: His writings have influenced the lives of millions.
examples.zh: 他的作品影响了千百万人。

examples.en: His experiences in India influenced his later writings.
examples.zh: 他在印度的经历影响了他后来的著作。

individual.mnemonic: in（进入，使）+ flu（流）+ ence（表示名词）→ 如涓涓细流般潜移默化 → 影响

pastExamSents.en: I don't think I could ever find the words to describe the positive influence you have had on my life.
pastExamSents.zh: 我想我无法用语言来形容您对我生活的积极影响。

pastExamSents.en: The influence has been less big in richer countries—with some even benefiting from higher temperatures.
pastExamSents.zh: 在较富裕的国家，影响就没那么大了——有些国家甚至能从温度升高中获益。

pastExamSents.en: It has also been shown to influence long-term memory.
pastExamSents.zh: 它还被证明会影响长期记忆。

pastExamSents.en: It has a great influence on the people who love nature.
pastExamSents.zh: 它对热爱自然的人们产生了很大的影响。

pastExamSents.en: It was a hard hit, but his influence stayed.
pastExamSents.zh: 这是一个沉重的打击，但他对我的影响仍然存在。

idiomatic.en: have an (good / bad) influence on / upon ...
idiomatic.zh: 对……有（好的 / 坏的）影响
